findings.heading: Preserve Session override presence
findings.finding: AppService.CreateSession parses a strict partial SessionSpec and copies only supplied keys over the selected preset. The setup script separately distinguishes omission, null and a string.
findings.action: Prototype one typed field behind the current facade. Compare omitted, zero, empty, null and invalid inputs with the current merge, including casing aliases and reconciliation using the same caller-minted Session ID.
findings.probe: The existing facade test covers omitted preset values, an explicit empty model, and setup-script null and replacement. Use additional field-specific null and default vectors before choosing a typed request shape.

findings.heading: Compare the Sessions settings loaders
findings.finding: Sessions still repeats settings fields in the cdk8s authoring model and the Go loader. The shared configfile package now owns common strict YAML decoding and safe errors.
findings.action: Use the Sessions pair to trial shared default and rejection vectors, including nested delegation entries and redacted credential errors. Choose a schema generator only after those vectors work.
findings.probe: A declaration comparison matched all 15 top-level serialized keys after excluding the Go environment-only field. That result covers names only.

findings.heading: Keep the browser diagnostics contract strict
findings.finding: The browser emits HistoryEvent marks; Python reads them through a discriminated union that rejects extra fields. These are test diagnostics with explicit privacy boundaries.
findings.action: Keep the current models and add one executable parity check when expanding the event contract. Exercise a known nullable field, an unknown kind and an extra field.
findings.probe: The source comparison matched 15 kinds, 36 non-discriminator fields, two nullable fields and the literal vocabularies.

findings.heading: Test generated Action client edge cases
findings.finding: The frontend uses generated Action messages. Its client still enforces required decision and request fields and explicitly maps status filters into query strings.
findings.action: Check absent principals, unknown state and unsupported outcome branches at the client boundary. Reuse the generated message schemas for valid payloads.

findings.heading: Keep historical Action policy evidence readable
findings.finding: The Action Store already tests historical policy evidence and rejects invalid domain values. Its conversion is an explicit compatibility boundary from persisted JSON to the service contract.
findings.action: Keep the existing vectors. Add a historical row only when storage or the public evidence shape changes.

scope: Selected contracts in tracked source. The declaration screen compares keys, types and literals. Runtime agreement requires coverage of serialization and accepted inputs.

validation.summary: Fresh Bazel checks passed for the App Session facade and Sessions configuration loader. The declaration comparison covers the current serialized keys and browser diagnostics union.
